request.description: `launch` flashes the firmware (unless disabled in `flashingConfig`), resets the chip and debugs it. `attach` connects to the running chip without flashing or resetting.

chip.description: Target chip as known by probe-rs (see `probe-rs chip list`), e.g. STM32F411CEUx, nRF52840_xxAA, RP2040. When omitted, Zembed looks for it in Embed.toml and in the `probe-rs run --chip` runner of .cargo/config.toml.

program.description: Path to the firmware ELF, absolute or relative to `cwd`. Shortcut for `coreConfigs[0].programBinary`.

svdFile.description: Path to a CMSIS-SVD file, absolute or relative to `cwd`. Shortcut for `coreConfigs[0].svdFile`.

rttEnabled.description: Enable RTT on the target. Shortcut for `coreConfigs[0].rttEnabled`.

cwd.description: Working directory used to resolve relative paths. Defaults to the worktree root.

probe.description: Debug probe selector, `VID:PID` or `VID:PID:Serial` (see `probe-rs list`). Needed only when several probes are plugged in.

wireProtocol.description: Wire protocol used by the probe.

connectUnderReset.description: Assert reset while connecting. Useful when the firmware disables the debug pins or sleeps.

chipDescriptionPath.description: Path to a custom target description YAML, for chips probe-rs does not ship.

allowEraseAll.description: Allow probe-rs to erase the whole chip, e.g. to unlock it.

consoleLogLevel.description: Verbosity of probe-rs messages in the debug console.

flashingConfig.description: Flashing options, `launch` only. Defaults to `{ "flashingEnabled": true }`.

haltAfterReset.description: Halt on the reset vector instead of running to the first breakpoint.

coreConfigs.description: Native probe-rs per-core configuration, for multi-core targets or full control. Values set here win over the top-level shortcuts.
